## Change

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior.

## Validation

List the meaningful checks you ran and any device checks still needed.

## Privacy and compatibility

- [ ] Examples, logs and screenshots contain only synthetic data and no credentials.
- [ ] Web/native impact and remaining device checks are described.
- [ ] Documentation and third-party notices are updated where needed.

Feature/fix pull requests target `dev`. Release pull requests go from `dev` to `main`.
